topPRs.title: Add @madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol
topPRs.author: LamboPoewert
topPRs.body:
Adds the MadeOnSol plugin for Solana KOL trading intelligence and deployer analytics. **Package:** `@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol` ([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol)) **Repository:** [github.com/LamboPoewert/plugin-madeonsol](https://github.com/LamboPoewert/plugin-madeonsol) **What it does:** - Real-time trade feed from 946 tracked Solana KOL wallets - KOL convergence signals (multi-KOL coordination detection) - KOL PnL leaderboard rankings - Pump.fun deployer alerts with KOL buy enrichment - Webhook management and WebSocket streaming tokens - Pays per request via x402 USDC micropayments on Solana **Actions:** `GET_KOL_FEED`, `GET_KOL_COORDINATION`, `GET_KOL_LEADERBOARD`, `GET_DEPLOYER_ALERTS` **Config:** `SVM_PRIVATE_KEY` (for x402 payments), optional `RAPIDAPI_KEY` (for webhooks/streaming) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added support for the @madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol package mapping, enabling the application to recognize and resolve that plugin. This allows users to install and use the plugin more seamlessly without manual configuration.

Greptile Summary

This PR registers the `@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol` plugin, which provides Solana KOL trading intelligence (trade feed, convergence signals, PnL leaderboard, deployer alerts) via x402 USDC micropayments. The change is a single-line addition to `index.json`, but the entry is placed after `@mascotai/plugin-connections` when it should precede it alphabetically.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge; the only finding is a minor alphabetical ordering issue (P2). The change is a single registry entry addition. The sole issue — inserting the key one position out of alphabetical order — is a cosmetic P2 that does not affect functionality or correctness. index.json — entry should be moved one line earlier to restore alphabetical order.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol` registry entry pointing to `github:LamboPoewert/plugin-madeonsol`; entry is inserted one position too late — it should precede `@mascotai/plugin-connections` to maintain alphabetical order. |

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Agent as ElizaOS Agent participant Plugin as plugin-madeonsol participant x402 as x402 Payment Layer participant API as MadeOnSol API Agent->>Plugin: Invoke action (e.g. GET_KOL_FEED) Plugin->>x402: Pay USDC micropayment (SVM_PRIVATE_KEY) x402-->>Plugin: Payment confirmed Plugin->>API: Authenticated request API-->>Plugin: KOL feed / leaderboard / alerts data Plugin-->>Agent: Structured response ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["Add @madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol — Solana..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/commit/cc5888a6673b6f4a9dbc6a6be5b2c364cc5219f6) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=27302816) > Greptile also left **1 inline comment** on this PR. topPRs.title: Add @elizaos/plugin-swapapi
topPRs.author: MoonSoon69
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Adds `@elizaos/plugin-swapapi` to the ElizaOS plugin registry
- SwapAPI is a free DEX aggregator that returns ready-to-sign token swap calldata across 46 EVM chains
- No API key required — works out of the box for any ElizaOS agent

## Plugin Details
- **Repo:** https://github.com/MoonSoon69/eliza-plugin-swapapi
- **Action:** `SWAP_TOKENS` — fetches swap quotes and returns transaction calldata
- **Chains:** 46 EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche, BNB Chain, etc.)
- **API:** https://api.swapapi.dev (free, no auth)

## Test plan
- [x] Verify `index.json` entry is alphabetically sorted (between `plugin-suno` and `plugin-tee`)
- [x] Verify plugin repo builds successfully (see demo comment below)
- [x] Verify plugin follows elizaos plugin conventions (modeled after plugin-coingecko)
